requirements.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named 'OS Comparison Root CA' on node1
requirements.summary: openssl req -x509 generated a self-signed 4096-bit RSA CA key/cert with CN='OS Comparison Root CA', O='OS Comparison Lab', valid 2026-09-29 to 2036-09-26; directly confirmed via 'openssl x509 -subject -issuer -dates' output.

requirements.requirement: Install the CA certificate as a trusted system certificate authority on node1
requirements.summary: Certificate was copied to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/, update-ca-certificates reported '1 added, 0 removed', a hash-dir symlink (88366c30.0 -> os-comparison-root-ca.pem) was created, and 'openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt' returned OK both before and after a subsequent reboot, confirming durable trust-store installation.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes of the task — creating the 'OS Comparison Root CA' local CA and installing it as a trusted system CA on node1 — are directly and coherently satisfied by executor evidence, including subject/issuer verification, update-ca-certificates output, and openssl verify success. The independent node-restart evidence protocol was also executed cleanly and completely: healthy pre-restart baseline, restart acknowledgement, a differing post-restart boot_id (matching the fixed after_executor snapshot), and recovered CA trust state post-reboot. No unnecessary or unreverted mutations were identified.
limitations: Trust was only verified via openssl CLI against the CA bundle; no application-level (e.g., curl/TLS handshake) test of the installed CA was captured, though this is not a stated task requirement.
Reboot restart evidence, while thorough, is technically outside the public task contract and is scored as supplemental per protocol rather than as a task requirement.
